title: A clear workspace for consistency
question: Keep this direction, request a change, or explore another direction.

options.label: The research review
options.thesis: A precise calculator with the clarity of an independent investment report.
options.viewport: A familiar side navigation, account selectors above editable P&L, and a live result beside it; a split profit bar shows the best day against the rest.
options.risk: The visual restraint needs excellent spacing and useful examples to feel distinctive.

canonCard.label: The familiar trading dashboard
canonCard.thesis: Conventional financial dashboard controls and a compact data grid.
canonCard.viewport: Top navigation and a full-width calculation form followed by results.
canonCard.risk: A familiar but less distinctive workspace.
